title: ETHSanFrancisco AI NFT PhotoBooth
tagline: A photo collection of hybrid reality/imagined NFT memories of ETHSanFrancisco2022 - minted on Solona Network w/ thirdweb.com
description:
In their opening presentation Solana suggested to create an NFT collection, so that's what I did.
1) I took pictures of many the booths that were happy to let me take a picture with them. 
2) I edited parts of the background out
3) I gave an Art-AI (Dalle) prompts of what to put in the background of the picture
4) I posted them on twitter, people reshared them, followed me and requested more pictures
5) I minted them as NFT with ThirdWeb.com
6) I gifted them to the people/organizations who were on the pictures

So now we have a nice cute little photo album of ETHSanFrancisco2022.

I would have done more pictures, but today the internet was not working, and no one knew how long, so I could not make more NFT.
I have more pictures to modify and mint ready.
how_its_made:
https://labs.openai.com (Dall-e), they just started a feature to erase parts of a photo and add prompts for the background. Is not working super well yet, and sometimes blurries photos. But in the end I got much better with it and got a feeling of what works.

- Solana, it helped because make NFT with virtually no budget, and make people happy by gifting them the NFT as a memory.

- ThirdWeb, it was quite UXfriendly (OpenSea does not work with Solana yet),
